spec.description: VF-010 (verification/findings.md): the fix budgets the own checker's branch probes in solver conflicts instead of wall-clock time. This job records the benchmark's own-checker runs at the fix's parent (c307e721, change ruvmympl, which added only the reproducer), for a later quick job to compare with run 1 of 2 at the fix, so that only the fix's effect is measured (the examples stream's pattern for VF-014). This job only records: it passes when the benchmark runs. Resubmitted for VF-021: the first pair (20261107-165544-...-run-1-of-2 and ...-s-parent-r) was stopped by SIGTERM because both ids share their first 40 characters, which the runner uses for a step's systemd scope (vjob-<id[:40]>-<step>), so each job's step stopped the other's as a leftover of the same name. These two ids differ within the first 40 characters. VF-021 closes when both pass and the comparison shows no verdict changed.
